svg.title: How Sighter works
svg.desc: Planned, nothing built yet. Six stages left to right: record screen and input events; label with OCR, template and detector suggestions, optional Pitwall vision and a human review queue; train a permissive YOLO-style detector with variation and a model registry; serve a local API with a layered resolver (cache, template, OCR anchor, detector, Pitwall grounding, needs labelling); test, in engineers' C#, Java or C++ tests through the locator client and in Sighter's own recorded flows; results as JUnit, TRX, Allure, Debrief run bundles and Pacenotes traceability. A retrain loop sends low-confidence results or UI changes to the review queue and on to retraining. A recovery loop sends a stuck step to Pitwall for a diagnosis and plan, runs a guarded recovery, reports passed with recovery and sends a proposal to the studio.
svg.text: Record it. Label it. Train it. Test it.
A local vision locator for UI automation: your tests find any element by sight, on your machine.
Local only · never a blind click · permissive licences only
Low confidence or UI change → retrain
The local AI hub. Optional: Sighter works without it.
Diagnoses a stuck step and plans a recovery
